# Script flow

How the script graph runs: containers, when each action finishes, loops, difficulty and how a battle ends.

Topic `script-flow`, declared by ops. Back to [the map](../README.md).

## Mechanisms

### PLAYED

- [dialog-reask-loop](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/dialog-reask-loop.md): A multiple-choice dialog can be asked again in a loop if the choice is reset before each ask (ops, verified 201602)
- [fog-switch](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/fog-switch.md): A script can switch the fog of war off with TGDDescriptorFow; whether it is map-wide and comes back on is unseen (ops, verified 201602)
- [gdscript-is-what-loads](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/gdscript-is-what-loads.md): An Operation runs from its compiled GDScript (build 201602's ndfbin, 210942's .txn), a compiled form of the stock Python (ops, verified 210942)
- [mission-ends-only-by-script](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/mission-ends-only-by-script.md): With CheckEndGame off, only the script's TriggerEndGame ends the battle, and the first one wins (ops, verified 201602)
- [script-container-semantics](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/script-container-semantics.md): How script containers run their children, and when each action finishes (ops, verified 201602)
- [script-effects-self-contained](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/script-effects-self-contained.md): A script launches a GameFx effect that takes no parameters, or a parameterised one through a wrapper of its own that binds them (ops, verified 210942)
- [scripted-nuke-effect](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/scripted-nuke-effect.md): A script plays the tactical-nuke impact effect only through a wrapper of its own that binds its parameters; a direct launch crashes the game (ops, verified 210942)
- [seteffect-never-finishes](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/seteffect-never-finishes.md): SetEffect and other lasting actions never finish, so nothing after them in a Sequential ever runs (ops, verified 201602)

### PROBED

- [objective-waits-until-resolved](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/objective-waits-until-resolved.md): An objective finishes only after it resolves and its chosen actions finish (ops, verified 201602)

### STOCK

- [camera-shot-from-current-position](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/camera-shot-from-current-position.md): Mid-battle, a script flies the camera from wherever it is to a one-key path, in a cutscene that can hold the view (ops, verified 201602)
- [difficulty-branches](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/difficulty-branches.md): Difficulty reaches a script as three conditions; give it a Medium baseline (ops, verified 201602)
- [scripted-economy](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/scripted-economy.md): A script sets the player's points, a zero income, one-time grants and a later income in stock's own nodes (ops, verified 201602)
- [wave-ends-with-attack](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/wave-ends-with-attack.md): An AI-less wave stops at its last waypoint unless its route ends with an Attack on the player's units (ops, verified 201602)

### UNTESTED

- [script-and-battle-scale](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/script-and-battle-scale.md): How big a script and a battle can get is untested beyond the probes (ops)

## Lessons

Taught by the trials of these mechanisms.

- [debrief-by-what-the-map-shows](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/debrief-by-what-the-map-shows.md) (core): Design probe results to show on the map, and debrief with a few multiple-choice questions about what was seen
- [decide-zones-by-count](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/decide-zones-by-count.md) (ops): Decide zone rules by timed counts and force the owner; keep real captures for flavour
- [effect-name-is-not-behaviour](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/effect-name-is-not-behaviour.md) (ops): An effect's name is not its behaviour; read its stock definition first
- [know-whether-an-action-finishes](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/know-whether-an-action-finishes.md) (ops): Know whether an action finishes before you put anything after it
- [no-stock-precedent-is-untested](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/no-stock-precedent-is-untested.md) (ops): No stock script does it means untested, whatever the API allows
- [one-stall-hides-the-rest](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/one-stall-hides-the-rest.md) (core): Put each probe beat in its own parallel branch, so one stall cannot hide the rest
- [precedent-includes-the-position](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/precedent-includes-the-position.md) (ops): A stock precedent includes where the node sits: what follows it, and in which container
- [prove-each-gate-both-ways](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/prove-each-gate-both-ways.md) (core): A gate is proven when it fails the bad build with the game's own words and passes every stock file
